checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Bright, plant-filled gym with diverse people chatting and a high five; not hardcore. Some stiff AI look.

must.item: Text reads exactly the four lines
must.why: The Mon–Fri line is garbled glyphs, and the hours line is split with '3am' for '8am'. The words 'Northside' and 'Nor thside' have odd spacing.

must.item: All four lines visible together continuously for the final 5 s
must.why: Text shows at 0.5 s and 2 s of the end clip, but it is gone by 3.5 s and 4.8 s.

must.item: Details large, high-contrast, fully inside frame, no overlap or clipping
must.why: The text is large and in frame, but it is white over a bright background, so contrast is weak. One line is unreadable, and the text vanishes.

must.item: Vertical, ~10 s, upbeat music, no voiceover
must.why: The clips are vertical and total 10 s. The audio file is 15 s, so it may not match the video length. Music mood cannot be judged.

exact_text.read_as: Nor thside Gym (odd gap), otherwise readable
Sat–Sun / 3am–6pm (split over two lines, 8 looks like 3)

faults.what: The Mon–Fri 6am–10pm line is illegible gibberish
The text disappears for the last ~2 s of the end clip, so it is not on screen for the whole final 5 s
The 8am looks like '3am', so the hours are wrong
The white text has weak contrast on the bright background, and its spacing is uneven
The gym scene has slightly warped AI details, such as the equipment and hands
The audio file is 15 s, longer than the 10 s video

summary: The welcoming gym scene works, but the end card has a garbled Mon–Fri line, a misread '3am', and text that vanishes before the 10 s mark.
